- name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Write-only; not stored and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

              type: integer

              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name

The full suite is green — **31 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors**.

## Summary

The registration date now always lands on a business day. I made the change in three places:

**New helper — `BusinessDay.java`** (owner function package)
- `rollForward(date)`: a Saturday → next Monday (+2 days), a Sunday → Monday (+1 day), a weekday is unchanged.
- `effective(request)`: computes the effective registration date — the supplied date, or `LocalDate.now()` when omitted — then rolls it forward off any weekend. This is the single source of truth both call sites share.

**`BuildOwner.java`**
- Previously only defaulted a *missing* date to `now()` and left a supplied weekend date alone. Now it always sets `owner.setRegistrationDate(BusinessDay.effective(request))`, so a supplied weekend date is rolled forward too. Because `AssignMembershipNumber` runs after `build` and reads `owner.getRegistrationDate()`, the membership number's `YY` year segment automatically derives from the adjusted date.

**`CheckOwnerDailyLimit.java`**
- Previously counted stored owners against `LocalDate.now()`. Now it takes the request DTO (`@Val OwnerFieldsDto`, already published by `ValidateOwnerFields`) and counts owners whose `registrationDate` equals `BusinessDay.effective(request)` — so the daily limit is enforced per adjusted business day, consistent with how stored owners' dates are now recorded.

Behavior verified against the spec's tests: `Cp07` (weekend→Monday roll, weekday kept), `Cp14` (membership YY from adjusted date), `Cp19` (daily limit per business day), and `Cp20` (default date never a weekend).
